analysis.summary: Montage test clip featuring three cozy scenes with hard cuts: late-night laptop typing, steaming coffee on a wooden table, and a rain-covered window with bokeh lights. The clip demonstrates scene transitions and maintains a warm, contemplative mood throughout with consistent amber lighting across the indoor scenes.

frames.text: Hands typing on a laptop keyboard in warm ambient lighting. A desk lamp glows in the background against darkness. The scene has a cozy, productive late-night work atmosphere with shallow depth of field focusing on the typing hands.
Continued typing scene with hands positioned on the laptop keyboard. Same warm lighting setup with the lamp visible. Intimate close-up of the work moment before the scene transition.
A steaming white coffee mug held by a hand on a wooden table surface. Wisps of steam rise dramatically against the dark background. Warm lighting creates a cozy morning coffee atmosphere.
Coffee mug centered on wooden table with elaborate steam curling upward. The steam forms artistic swirls against the black background. Strong warm lighting from the side creates dramatic contrast.
Same coffee mug composition with rising steam. The steam pattern continues to evolve, creating organic flowing shapes. Warm amber lighting on the wooden surface.
Rain-streaked window with water droplets covering the glass. Blurred city lights create colorful bokeh circles (orange, blue) behind the wet surface. Moody, contemplative rainy day atmosphere.
